name: Tom

beschreibung.text: Analog tom: two squares a minor seventh apart with a quick pitch drop, resonant filter thump and a short room.

notiz: Source rule: recipe card `percussion.tom`, Welsh [B1] p. 83, patch Timpani, table transcribed; the tom/timpani distinction: Reid [B2] part 31. Measured by `tests/rezepte.rs`, not yet heard. Manifest character words outside the vocabulary: boomy (as thick). Manifest use words outside the vocabulary: groove (as drop).
